jobs.title: Founding Product Manager, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description:
Overview

Mesh is seeking a Founding PM for Agentic Commerce.

AI agents will change how commerce and payments work. Every payment flow today assumes a human is present ... someone to look at the price and click confirm. Agents break that assumption, and no one knows what replaces it. Mesh needs to be at the front lines finding out.

This role is unlike any other PM role at Mesh. There is no product to ship yet. Your job is to figure out how agents will buy, sell, and move money. You will build with the emerging protocols, embed in the community, and run experiments on live payment rails, working directly with our SVP of Product to turn what you learn into where Mesh bets.

The space is noisy and it's easy to get lost in the wilderness. To succeed, you need to both think and do. Thinking without doing is just speculation. Doing without thinking is giving in to FOMO. You need to form strong hypotheses, then prove or kill them.

What You'll Do

 - Be the center of gravity for agentic commerce at Mesh. Every question about agents and money movement routes to you ... what's real, what's hype, what we test, what we ignore. If an agent touches a payment, you have a view on it.

 - Be the expert the company doesn't have yet. The protocols, the standards bodies, the model capabilities, the startups, the failures. When a customer asks "what is Mesh's agent story?", you are where the answer comes from ... and today, no one at Mesh can answer it.

 - Build the proof, hands-on. Working agents completing real transactions on live rails ... not decks, not memos. You write the code, wire up the protocols, and run the experiments. When an experiment needs a customer, you recruit them from our existing base.

 - Represent Mesh at the frontier. Protocol working groups, hackathons, the rooms where standards get set. Mesh should be a name in agentic commerce before it has a product there ... you are how that happens.

 - Make the case for what Mesh builds first. When a hypothesis survives, the work changes: write the case, size the bet, and defend it with the SVP of Product. The strength of your evidence determines the speed of the company.

Who You Are

 - Experience: You have built something real without being told what to build ... a very early startup, a side project strangers actually used, an agent that can buy or book or trade ... and you learned something from it that most people don't know.

 - Builder: You can take an idea to a working prototype yourself ... code, APIs, and AI tools ... and you don't wait for permission or resources to start. You will be asked to show something you built and walk through the decisions inside it.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: You form positions before you have full information, and you change them when the evidence turns. You can describe a conviction you held, what killed it, and what you did next.

 - Domain: Crypto or payments experience is a plus, not a requirement. Genuine curiosity about how money moves is required.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Onchain
jobs.description:
Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our "Core" team. This team builds the foundational infrastructure that handles crypto transfers, bridging logic, and network connectivity.  Your initial mandate will be to aggressively expand Mesh's footprint by leading our integration strategy for Centralized Exchanges (CEXs) and Web3 Wallets.

Here is the truth about what it takes to succeed in this role: you must possess raw intellectual horsepower, a deep pride in the quality of your work, and a relentless, undeniable work ethic.  Some Web3 experience is preferred; exceptional execution is mandatory. We will teach you the crypto infrastructure.  If you can drop into a highly complex, ambiguous technical domain, figure out how it works, and start driving outcomes immediately, you belong here.

What You'll Do

 - Ownership: You are the execution engine for the Core team. If a process is broken, you fix it. If an engineering team is blocked, you unblock them. You take pride in sweating the details that others ignore.

 - Expand the Network: Own the execution for expanding Mesh's coverage of external platforms. You will figure out how to integrate new crypto exchanges and standardize connections with self-custodial wallets.

 - Architect for Scale: Partner with our Head of Core and senior engineers to ensure that as we add dozens of new connections, our routing logic remains standardized, scalable, and secure. You will write crystal-clear specs and map out edge cases.

 - High Leverage & Efficiency: You ruthlessly optimize and automate your own operational workflows. You treat your time as the company's most valuable resource, utilizing modern tools (AI, scripts, automations) to scale your output so you can focus on high-impact problem-solving.

 - Cross-Functional Velocity: Collaborate tightly with Engineering and Business Development to prioritize the right integrations and ensure our core connectivity meets the SLAs required by our enterprise clients.

Who You Are 

 - Experience: 3+ years of building and shipping hard things. Traditional technical PM experience is preferred but not strictly required.  

 - Intellectual Horsepower: You are a rapid learner who can quickly deconstruct complex systems (APIs, ledgers, financial routing) and explain them simply.

 - Relentless Drive: You have a demonstrated history of working incredibly hard and caring deeply about the output of your work. You do not wait to be told what to do.

 - Systems Thinking: You are highly comfortable reading technical documentation, discussing API payloads, and debating architectural tradeoffs with engineers. You don't need to write code, but you must be able to design systems.

The annual base salary range for this role is $186,000 - $241,000 in San Francisco and New York. The compensation range provided may span multiple career levels and will be narrowed during the interview process based on factors including a candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. For candidates outside of San Francisco and New York, compensation will be adjusted to reflect the applicable market and location-based pay band. The base salary range listed excludes commission (if applicable), equity, and benefits. The pay range represents the minimum and maximum target for new-hire compensation. Actual compensation may vary and may be higher or lower depending on individual circumstances.
